interestingFact: India is the birthplace of four major world religions: Hinduism, Buddhism, Jainism, and Sikhism.
The Eiffel Tower in Paris was once the tallest man-made structure in the world.
Japan has more than 6,800 islands, but only about 430 of them are inhabited.
Brazil is home to about 60% of the Amazon rainforest, the largest rainforest on Earth.
Australia is home to more than 80% of plant and animal species found nowhere else on Earth.
Germany has over 1,500 different types of beer and around 300 varieties of bread.
Italy has more UNESCO World Heritage Sites than any other country in the world.
South Africa has three capital cities: Pretoria, Cape Town, and Bloemfontein.
Russia spans 11 time zones, more than any other country in the world.
